raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have an account at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Revolut"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have an account at"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Raiffeisen"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "should use for paying rent"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end
